Independent review of node session-on-its-run-keeps-its-contracts, read at
head 3eb57e55ac50452a71a1fb07a30c44575e59e685 against base
c6abaeb9c1fe7e932ee3cd46475632672ea11975. Sources read: the source node's
prompt and manifest, its suite-delta evidence, the eight landed commits, and
two re-runs I made myself in the reviewed worktree.

VERDICT goal: the goal is that the session-on-its-run change keeps every
contract it broke that was not about roster writes; the seven named regressions
are repaired by restoring each contract rather than rewriting its test —
reckon/crew/dispatch.py no longer writes a dialect key into the recorded agent
configuration, reckon/crew/promotion.py:3981 carries session_harness and
session_model onto the ledger row, and reckon/crew/routing.py:1288 wraps member
registration in the pointer lock.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when is the importer gate — the seven ids plus
tests/test_session_lives_on_its_run.py green, and no added failure outside four
peer-held files; the manifest records the base arm at c6abaeb9 (7 failed, 7
passed) and the repair arm at 199069f1 (14 passed), and my re-run of the same
eight targets at 3eb57e55 gave 14 passed, EXIT=0 (review-focused-gate.log);
the no-added-failures clause is not met at head — three added failures stand
outside the exempt files, reported by the node as blockers rather than repaired.
VERDICT write_paths: the declared fence is the seven production modules, eight
test files and the three landing-record paths; the diff c6abaeb9..3eb57e55
touches nine files — reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/runs.py,
reckon/ledger.py, reckon/crew/routing.py, reckon/crew/promotion.py,
tests/test_crew_ephemeral_members.py, docs/plans/new-work-gets-a-new-worker.html,
docs/evidence/archive/new-work-gets-a-new-worker-landed.html and a new figure —
every one inside the declared paths.
VERDICT manifest: read at
r-20260925T033627599580-session-on-its-run-keeps-its-contracts/manifest.md; it
is a blocked record, not a complete one, and that is the honest state: it names
the eight commits, both suite arms with revisions and log paths, the executed
negative control, and three blockers naming the residual failures with whether
each asserts the roster write.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit; the five repair commits each restore one
contract (agent shape, resume wording, stream-session resolution without
caching stream identity, session classification before dialect resolution,
serialized member registration), and the three later commits carry no
behaviour change — a figure, two comment blocks in reckon/crew/promotion.py and
reckon/crew/runs.py verified comment-only line by line, and appended plan and
evidence prose — so the suite arm taken at 199069f1 measures the same code as
the head it is reported against.
